content:
Jordan: quick watercooler poll — if each popular open model were an office pet, what would they be? e.g. Llama2 = golden retriever, Mistral = hyperactive husky :dog2:
Priya: Mistral is totally the raccoon that steals your sandwich from the fridge :rofl:
Marco: Llama2 = patient labrador that follows you to meetings, Falcon = aloof cat that ignores pings until treated with treats :cat: 
Sam: tiny poll — react with :dog2: for dog, :cat: for cat, :fish: for goldfish, :raccoon: for chaotic neutral raccoon
Rika: also can we start calling the noisy test model "Eric" because it meows at 3am whenever someone runs a stress test :scream_cat:
Jordan: haha yes. my ranking: Llama2=dog, Mistral=raccoon, Vicuna=curious kitten, OpenAssistant=wise owl (but would definitely hide pens)
Priya: Vicuna = needy kitten that wants constant prompt-tuning. "feed me tokens" :taco:
Marco: quick system prompt for the Vicuna kitten persona:
```
You are a tiny kitten model. Respond in 1-2 sentences, include one adorable complaint about snacks.
```
Sam: love that. low-effort mascot idea: plush raccoon for Mistral, build a tiny scarf that says "I cached your prefix" :merch_idea:
Rika: can we launch "bring-your-model-to-lunch" day? everyone brings a plush, we vote on best anthropomorphized model :thumbsup: :heart_eyes:
Jordan: @lunchbot what are the odds we get free snacks for that?
lunchbot: Heads up — "Bring Your Model" lunch is tentatively approved. Catering TBD. 
Priya: if catering happens I'm voting for pizza and chips (for the raccoons) :pizza: :chipmunk: 
Sam: tagging design -> could be a fun banner: "Adopt a Model — Who's Your Office Pet?"
Marco: final note: whoever makes a sticker set of these gets my endorsement. I'll prototype a raccoon stealing a sandwich sticker.
Rika: agreed. also someone please stop naming random infra hosts after pets, my pager now says "raccoon-3" at 2am and i'm scarred :sweat_smile:
